description: This file contains utility functions for handling ARIA roles, accessible names, and related accessibility features within a web environment, including role inference, attribute checks, and content parsing for accessibility purposes.

methods.name: hasExplicitAccessibleName
methods.description: Checks if an element has an explicit accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

methods.name: hasGlobalAriaAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an element has any global ARIA attributes, optionally considering role restrictions.

methods.name: hasTabIndex
methods.description: Determines if an element is focusable via tabindex attribute.

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively focusable or has a tabindex.

methods.name: isNativelyFocusable
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively focusable based on its tag and attributes.

methods.name: getImplicitRoleByTagName
methods.description: Infers implicit ARIA role based on element tag name and attributes.

methods.name: getExplicitAriaRole
methods.description: Retrieves the explicit ARIA role assigned via role attribute.

methods.name: getAriaRole
methods.description: Determines the ARIA role of an element, considering explicit and implicit roles.

methods.name: getAriaBoolean
methods.description: Converts ARIA attribute string to boolean or undefined.

methods.name: isElementIgnoredForAria
methods.description: Checks if an element is ignored for ARIA purposes (e.g., style, script, template).

methods.name: isElementHiddenForAria
methods.description: Determines if an element is hidden from ARIA, considering display, aria-hidden, and other factors.

methods.name: belongsToDisplayNoneOrAriaHiddenOrNonSlotted
methods.description: Recursively checks if an element is hidden due to display:none, aria-hidden, or shadow DOM.

methods.name: getIdRefs
methods.description: Resolves IDREFs to DOM elements, considering shadow DOM boundaries.

methods.name: parseCSSContentPropertyAsString
methods.description: Parses CSS content property into a string, supporting attr() and other tokens.

methods.name: getCSSContent
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS content property value, considering pseudo-elements.

methods.name: getAccessibleNameInternal
methods.description: Computes the accessible name of an element following the ARIA and HTML spec.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleName
methods.description: Returns the accessible name of an element, optionally including hidden elements.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleDescription
methods.description: Returns the accessible description of an element based on aria-describedby, aria-description, or title.

methods.name: getAriaInvalid
methods.description: Returns the ARIA invalid state of an element.

methods.name: getValidityInvalid
methods.description: Checks if an element's validity state is invalid.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with an element via aria-errormessage or validation states.

methods.name: getTextAlternativeInternal
methods.description: Recursively computes the text alternative for accessibility, considering labels, roles, and content.

methods.name: innerAccumulatedElementText
methods.description: Accumulates text content from an element and its children for accessibility name calculation.

methods.name: getAriaSelected
methods.description: Determines if an element is selected according to ARIA.

methods.name: getAriaChecked
methods.description: Determines the checked state of an element with ARIA roles.

methods.name: getCheckedAllowMixed
methods.description: Gets checked state allowing 'mixed'.

methods.name: getCheckedWithoutMixed
methods.description: Gets checked state disallowing 'mixed'.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Internal function to determine checked state, considering indeterminate and ARIA attributes.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Returns whether an element is readonly based on ARIA and native attributes.

methods.name: getAriaPressed
methods.description: Returns the pressed state of a toggle button.

methods.name: getAriaExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether an element is expanded, based on ARIA and native attributes.

methods.name: getAriaLevel
methods.description: Returns the ARIA level of a heading, listitem, or treeitem.

methods.name: getAriaDisabled
methods.description: Determines if an element is disabled via native or ARIA attributes.

methods.name: hasExplicitAccessibleName
methods.description: Checks if an element has an explicit accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

methods.name: receivesPointerEvents
methods.description: Determines if an element receives pointer events, considering CSS pointer-events and shadow DOM.
